style.rendering: Flat custom monoline pictograms, confident softly rounded strokes with little asymmetrical character, sparse details, all same stroke weight. Original illustration, not SF Symbols or a stock library.
style.shape_base: None. Each icon floats alone on transparent alpha, no disks, tiles, shadows or colored panels.

layout.grid: EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, equal square cells, one icon centered in each. Each symbol occupies 70 percent of cell width/height. Clear equal margins. Square overall image.

icons: row1col1: video camera with small play cutout
row1col4: person bust within an open arch
constraints: Transparent background, no text or labels or grid lines, no embossing, no colored surfaces. Exactly 16 distinct complete icons, correct order. Solid opaque strokes, empty areas transparent.

refinement.request: Keep all sixteen icons and their 4x4 positions; remove white speckles, colored flecks and halos from all negative space; retain only smooth mint glyphs on transparent alpha.

final_refinement.prompt: Preserve all original symbols, identities, colors and equal grid positions. Remove contaminated alpha fringes and speckles. Navigation: redraw as pure white strokes on pure black, for native luminance-mask display. Illustrations and collection: opaque uniform #132A26 matte, no background texture or shadows, clean subject edges.
